content.short: Apricot Finance is a decentralized lending protocol on Solana.
content.description: Apricot Finance is a lending protocol built on Solana that enables leveraged yield farming. Its goal is to help users maximize yield while reducing risk. The platform lets users deposit assets to earn interest (Apricot Lend), borrow assets for trading or yield farming (Apricot Cross-Farm), and tailor automated deleveraging (Apricot Assist) to their preferences. By combining lending, borrowing, and automated risk controls, Apricot Finance aims to help traders and yield farmers optimize positions and pursue amplified returns.
